parameters.jsCode: return { json: { ...$json, _to: String($('CONFIG').first().json.config.CANDIDATE_EMAIL).trim() } };

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ Start here
1. Create the 6 credentials with the exact names from the README.
2. Open **CONFIG** and fill in SHEET_ID, CANDIDATE_EMAIL, CV_DRIVE_FILE_ID (+ TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID).
3. Settings → Error workflow → this workflow.
4. Keep **TEST_MODE: true** until the end-to-end test is done.

Every trigger sets `flow`, CONFIG adds the settings, *Route to flow* sends it to its lane.

## WF1 · Job Collector (every 8 h)
Arbeitsagentur API (official) + RSS feeds → only IT roles → not yet in the sheet → job details, company e-mail from the post, VisaFlag, Language → Jobs tab, Status **New** → digest.

## WF2 · AI Drafter (every 30 min)
Status **Selected** → one tailored German + English letter per job (OpenAI) → DraftDE / DraftEN, Status **Draft Ready** → Telegram with the draft. Gurwinder edits, then sets **Approved**.

## WF3 · Sender (every 30 min) — only after approval
Status **Approved** → company e-mail from the job post? yes: Gmail + CV → **Applied** · no: **Manual Apply** + Telegram with link + letter. TEST_MODE sends everything to Gurwinder himself.

## WF4 · Follow-up (daily 08:00)
**Applied** + 7 days → follow-up 1 · **Follow-up 1** + 7 days → follow-up 2 · **Manual Apply** → reminder to Gurwinder (never to the company).

## WF5 · Weekly report (Monday 09:00)
Counts per status + this week → Log, e-mail, Telegram.

## Error alerts
Any failed node → Log tab + Telegram. Needs Settings → Error workflow = this workflow.
